optimizedContext.value:
# Storage
## Rules
### Change directory naming
- Format `YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-<name>` from create time. Prefix filesystem-only — not domain/manifest/CLI. Resolve by glob `*-<name>`.
### Change directory listing order
- `list()` → `createdAt` ascending. Fs: active-changes index under `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/changes/`.
### Artifact status derivation
- Status derived at load (not stored). Manifest stores `validatedHash` only. Precedence: `__skipped__`→skipped; absent→missing; cleaned hash match→complete; else in-progress.
- Cleaned hash = `preHashCleanup` then SHA-256. Skip drift if `artifactTypes.length === 0`.
### Artifact dependency cascade
- `effectiveStatus`: complete hash still in-progress if any `requires` chain not complete/skipped. Skipped optional satisfies deps.
### ValidateArtifacts sole path to complete
- `markComplete` / `markSkipped` (`__skipped__`) only via validate/skip use cases.
### Archive pattern
- `storage.archive.pattern`: `{{year}}`, `{{month}}`, `{{day}}`, `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.archivedName}}`. Default `{{change.archivedName}}`.
- NOT supported: `{{change.scope}}`, `{{change.workspace}}` → `UnsupportedPatternError` at construction.
- `{{month}}`/`{{day}}` zero-padded; `{{year}}` four digits.
### Archive index
- List index under `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/archive/` — not archive root. Files: `.specd-index.jsonl` (`{ entry, sourceMtime?, sourceFiles? }`), `.specd-index-meta.json` (`{ totalCount, generatedAt, isInvalidated }`).
- `reindex()` rebuilds fs-cache; migrate-and-forget legacy root indexes; orphan cleanup on rebuild only.
- `get` MAY scan; MUST NOT depend on root JSONL for routine reads.
### Archive runtime ignore
- Archive root `.gitignore` MUST ignore `.staging`. Do not re-add obsolete index ignore lines after migration.
### Named storage factories
- Select by adapter name; VCS/null-VCS stays inside factory.
### Change manifest / path confinement / staged archive
- Manifest per core:change-manifest; atomic write (temp+rename).
- Reject paths escaping storage root / untracked files.
- Prefer staged commit for multi-update archive.
### Change locks
- `{configPath}/tmp/change-locks` derived from `ChangeRepositoryConfig.configPath`.
### Fs list index cache layout
```
{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/
  archive/ changes/ drafts/ discarded/
  specs/<workspace>/
  validate-specs/<workspace>/
```
- Access only via index helpers (`FsChangeIndexCache`, `FsSpecIndexCache`). `include*` = projection only.
### Validation result cache bucket
- Extends meta with `schemaFingerprint`, `engineVersion`. Rows: `{ entry, stamps, cacheFingerprint }`. Hosts need no dedicated reindex surface.
### configPath tmp gitignore
- `{configPath}/tmp/.gitignore`: `*` + `!.gitignore`. Idempotent create on first use / initProject.
## Constraints
- Manifest writes atomic (temp+rename).
- Fs-cache paths use forward slashes regardless of OS.
- Dir-name timestamp from `change.createdAt`, not wall clock at write.
- `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/` runtime caches — MUST NOT commit to VCS.
